audio_generation.reason: a real provider (openai) synthesised audio for every one of the 40 cases; each is recorded by format, size and duration.

loopback_semantics.reason: an isolated in-process byte path: the synthesised bytes are handed straight to the recogniser - no loudspeaker, no microphone, no room, no feedback loop. The match proves the spoken text survives synthesis and recognition; it proves nothing about what a person hears.

physical_hearing.reason: never claimed by this harness: only the owner's ear, on the owner's device, can prove it (docs/OWNER_ACTIONS.md audio items).
